description: Ministry of Defence - Name Lists of Videshasewa, Deshaputhra Sammana, Long Service, etc., Medals & Clasps
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists the names and ranks of military personnel (Naval and Air Force officers, sailors) who are being awarded medals and honors (Videsha Seva Padakkama, Desha Puthra Sammanaya, Long Service Medal). It names specific individuals but does not describe any detailed portfolio responsibilities, government structural changes, or administrative functions. The content is purely about government personnel changes (awards), fitting the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
